title: Romo again falls short in elusive bid for U.S. Ope...

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Romo again falls short in elusive bid for U.S. Ope...
sources.description: Former Cowboys QB Tony Romo will have to try another year to make it to the U.S. Open after he shot a 9-over 79 and missed out by 11 shots in a local qualifier.
